content.text:
context.layout = layout
        context.plan = plan
        context.env = {}
        context.requires = module.requires
        machine = self.machine
        if machine is None:
            context.state_param = None
            context.message_param = None
        else:
            context.state_param = machine.state_param
            context.message_param = machine.message_param
        context.apps = self._applications(module, context.env)
        return context

    def _applications(self, module, env):
        """Every composed pipe application of an entry, parents first."""
        applications = []
        queue = deque([(module, env)])
        while queue:
            current, parent_env = queue.popleft()
            for pipe in self.pipes_by_target.get(current.name, ()):
                target = self.modules[pipe.filter]
                application = Application(target, parent_env, pipe.bind)
                applications.append(application)
                queue.append((target, application.env))
        return applications

    # -- replay ---------------------------------------------------------
    def run(self):
        """Compile plans, replay every record, and assemble the corpus."""
        plans = [context.plan for context in self.contexts]
        records = []
        corpus = Corpus()
        machine = self.machine
        append = records.append
        mask_cache = {}
        for index, item in enumerate(self.runs):
            context = self.context_by_entry.get(item['entry'])
            if context is None:
                append({'status': INVALID_TEST})
                continue
            layout = context.layout
            try:
                objects = wire.decode(item['ktest'])
                leaves, flag = layout.decode(objects)
            except (wire.TransportError, InventoryError, ValueError, TypeError,
                    KeyError, AttributeError, struct.error, OverflowError):
                append({'status': INVALID_TEST})
                continue
            inputs, result = layout.values(leaves)
            env = context.env
            for name, value in inputs.items():
                env[name] = value
            # The flag attests to pipe acceptance only, so it is checked
            # before any predicate can filter the record.
            accepted = context.accepts()
            if layout.flag is not None and flag != (0 if accepted else 1):
                append({'status': INVALID_TEST})
                continue
            if not accepted or not context.requires.evaluate(env):
                append({'status': FILTERED})
                continue
            key = corpus_key(context.name, inputs)
            cost = 0
            commands = ()
            if machine is not None:
                prepared_mask = mask_cache.get(key)
                if prepared_mask is None:
                    prepared_mask = machine.mask(env)
                    if len(mask_cache) >= 8192:
                        mask_cache.clear()
                    mask_cache[key] = prepared_mask
                prepared = machine.preparer.prepare(
                    prepared_mask, machine.index[inputs[context.state_param]])
                if prepared is None:
                    append({'status': UNREACHABLE})
                    continue
                cost, preamble = prepared
                commands = list(preamble)
                commands.append(inputs[context.message_param])
            case, fresh = corpus.intern(key, context.name, inputs, cost,
                                        commands, index)
            append({'status': READY if fresh else DUPLICATE, 'case': case,
                    'model_result': result})
        return {'plans': plans, 'records': records, 'corpus': corpus.rows}


def execute(campaign):
    """Compile and replay one campaign, returning its JSON certificate."""
    return Campaign(campaign).run()
